title: Scenes
description: scenes/<file>.json: the dialogue that plays an arc beat out. A scene is a small graph of nodes; each node shows lines, then moves on, offers the party options, or ends. Data only: the exploration runtime (sub-project 5) plays it, and nothing here needs it to exist.

beat.description: Optional: the arcs.json beat this scene plays out; omit for an interaction hook. A beat can have several scenes (an approach, the beat itself, an aftermath).

place.description: A place id from regions.json. Defaults to the beat's place.

requires.description: The scene only plays when every flag is set (on top of the beat's own requires).

unless.description: The scene doesn't play if any of these flags is set (for the version of a scene that depends on an earlier choice).

after.description: Only on a battle beat: the scene is the aftermath, played after the fight is won. Unmarked scenes are the lead-in, played before it. A beat's aftermath scenes come after all its lead-in scenes.

cast.description: Who appears: character ids, and 'narrator'. Every line's speaker must be in it.

camp.description: Optional once-per-campaign camp reflection; never part of the normal beat chain.

node.description: Shows its lines in order, sets its flags, then: options (the party picks), next (carry on), or end. Exactly one of the three.

sets.description: Flags set when the node plays. Must be flags arcs.json sets (the checker enforces it).

vote.description: The options are a party vote (mockup 02): everyone picks, the leader breaks ties. Otherwise the player who's talking picks.

gold.description: Party gold gained or spent once when resolved.

spoken.description: A line of dialogue: the common line's fields plus who says it. The id is stable, so translations and voice files key on it.

speaker.description: A character id from characters.json, or 'narrator'.

direction.description: How to deliver it, for a voice actor or an expressive TTS model. Never shown.

option.description: Something the party can say or do. Options are shown as text and aren't voiced: player characters speak through their voice sets' barks.

to.description: The node it leads to. Omit only when a check decides.

choice.description: The arcs.json choice this option is (its flags are set when it wins). Only in a vote.

requires.description: Only offered when these flags are set.

tags.description: Only offered when someone in the party has one of these: a background (backgrounds.json), a race or a class (rules ids).

check.description: A skill check: one picked roller, or every present hero when group is true. Pass and fail each go to a node.

group.description: Every present hero rolls; half or more must succeed.

gold.description: Party gold gained or spent once when resolved.
